govdocs-archive_org-nsia-AssassinationJF: U.S. News & World Report covered the thirtieth anniversary of the Kennedy assassination in 1993, and this file holds that coverage as captured. The weekly newsmagazines treated each major anniversary as a reckoning: the state of the evidence, the standing of the Warren Report, and the researchers still at work. Kept complete, the coverage shows how the case was presented to mainstream American readers three decades on, when the newest assassination files were just beginning to open.
